verdict.rationale: Segment's automation-like features (Functions, Audiences, Tracking Plans, Reverse ETL) have no documented versioning, change-review, or rollback mechanism in the evidence pack; the only 'versioning' mention (segment-docs-x2) refers to Public API version compatibility, not automation/workflow history or rollback. Missing for 10: any evidence of change history, diff/review UI, or rollback capability for Functions, Audiences, or Tracking Plans.
